scene_description: Wood-grain desk in a cubicle, with a white panel on the left and a gray fabric partition at the back. A blue composition notebook leans upright in the back-left corner with an unopened purple coffee can in front of it. An opened red coffee can stands alone. Front is the open edge of the desk.

targets.name: blue notebook
targets.description: Blue 'College Ruled' composition notebook standing on its bottom edge and leaning against the back partition in the back-left corner, with the purple can in front of it.
targets.orientation: leaning, standing on its bottom edge against the partition
nearby_obstacles: White left panel at its spine edge
Purple coffee can touching the lower-left of its front cover
targets.clearance_notes: Top edge and right side are open; the corner and the purple can crowd the left and lower front.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the purple can approximately 10 cm toward the front of the desk, clear of the notebook.

targets.other_notes: Dimensions are for the notebook lying flat.

targets.name: purple coffee can
targets.description: Unopened purple 'Chameleon Latte classic' can in the back-left corner, standing directly in front of the leaning notebook.
nearby_obstacles: White left panel about 2 cm to its left
targets.clearance_notes: Open to the front and right, but boxed in by the notebook behind and the panel on its left.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the purple can approximately 10 cm toward the front of the desk, out of the corner.

targets.name: red coffee can
targets.description: Opened red 'Chameleon Latte double shot' can standing alone in the open middle of the desk, well in front of and to the right of the notebook.
targets.other_notes: Tab is pulled open; keep upright in case it holds liquid.

source: Staged permutation of S0019, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
